title: Q3 Roadmap: Hosted API Stabilizations & Model Lineup Prioritization
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Synthesize cross-functional priorities for Q3 focused on two linked areas: (1) reducing P95 latency regressions and improving predictability for hosted API customers, and (2) producing a prioritized list of model variants (the 'model lineup') to support tiered SLAs and cost targets. This ticket captures the planning artifact used to align Product, Eng, Design, and Sales on scope, success metrics, trade-offs, and rollout plan. Outcomes expected: a committed Q3 initiative list with owners, a phased rollout plan for model variants, example customer impact scenarios, and a monitoring/guardrail plan for quality regressions.
goals: Decrease hosted API P95 serving latency by 15% for standard routes without increasing per-token cost by more than 5%
Define and publish a model lineup with 3 supported tiers (fast, standard, economical) and quantization/variant recommendations
Establish rollback and canary thresholds tied to quality regressions (BLEU/ROUGE proxy + prompt-based evals) and latency SLOs
Enable self-serve migration docs and SDK samples for customers to opt into model tiering
milestones: Documentation & SDK examples ready for beta customers (2026-05-15)
acceptance_criteria: PM/Eng/Design sign-off on the prioritized lineup and rollout phases
Benchmarked latency/cost table for each model variant with representative routes
Canary gating rules documented and implemented in Redwood Console test cluster
At least two beta customers passed through migration flow with no critical regressions
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Best-performing open models change unexpectedly (fresh weights/optimizations). Mitigation: include fallback variants and weekly model-revalidation job.
Risk: Tail-latency increases from batching changes. Mitigation: conservative batching defaults and route-level overrides.
Risk: Migration causes customer confusion. Mitigation: clear SDK flags, migration playbook, and managed migration option via Solutions team.
tasks: Run cost & latency sims for top 8 candidate model variants
Create sample SDK flags and migration guide PR
Design console UX for model-tier selection and rollout visibility
Define canary metrics and implement alerting dashboards
Coordinate beta with 2 high-usage Hosted API customers

notes: Trade-offs discussed: tighten latency SLOs vs. preserving current throughput and cost. We are recommending a phased approach that first targets high-traffic standard routes.
Decision: Use a conservative quantization profile for 'economical' tier during beta to reduce risk of quality regression; research to run heavier evals in parallel.
